text_block_list.text: After going out with Gold City—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Before we head home, you know... 
There's a place I want to go."
choice_data_list: Somewhere you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Mm, follow me.

Without being told the reason, I boarded 
the train led by Gold City.

An awkward silence hangs between me and 
the quiet Gold City. Just where on earth 
are we heading?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... ...*exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wow... It's just like the magazine 
said!
choice_data_list: Is that a place featured in that magazine?
Is that a place featured in that magazine?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was in that guide we bought 
together earlier. Says this mountain 
stream is a quiet, relaxing spot!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll go check it out real quick!

"Taking off her shoes, Gold City dips her 
legs into the river."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
S-So cold! Ahaha, what is this? It's crazy 
how freezing this is!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Eek!?
choice_data_list: City!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That scared me. It was just a leaf stuck 
to my leg.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look closely and you can see fish 
swimming! Trainer, come check this out!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! That stall over there has 
salt-grilled river fish. You never really 
see that in the city, do you...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's buy it! I wanna eat that!
choice_data_list: Is it okay to eat this before dinner?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Since you're here, let's eat 
together!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, total bliss. That was so 
soothing...!
choice_data_list: ...Did that help refresh you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...What, you saw right through me?
choice_data_list: Did something happen?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...It's no big deal, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: There's a big show coming up soon, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to it, but there were a lot of 
meetings, you know? And maybe way more 
higher-ups than usual, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I just wanted to catch my 
breath once before the real thing.
choice_data_list: So you've been tense the whole time, huh.

So you've been on edge this whole time, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait... I got to rest, but does this 
mean it turned into work for you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm... sorry for making you take a day 
off.
choice_data_list: There's no need for you to apologize.
There's no need for you to apologize.
I've spent some truly precious time here.
Is there anything else you want to do?
Is there anything else you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm... sorry for making you take a day 
off.
choice_data_list: There's no need for you to apologize.
There's no need for you to apologize.
I've spent some truly precious time here.
Is there anything else you want to do?
Is there anything else you want to do?

text_block_list.text:
Refreshing yourself leads to better 
running. When I told her that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So it really is work after all.
choice_data_list:
Still, I had fun, so invite me again 
sometime.

Still, I had fun, so please invite me 
again.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you're so serious. You look like 
you suck at taking breaks too, so I'll 
bring you along again sometime.

Where will Gold City take me next? Just 
thinking about it made my heart flutter a 
little.

Opportunities to see Gold City act so 
naturally like today don't come around 
often. When I told her that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah. Feels a bit late to try 
acting cool now anyway...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Just so you know, don't go telling 
people that I was getting all excited, 
okay?
choice_data_list: I know, it's a secret, okay?
I know, it's a secret, okay?

text_block_list.text:
It ended up being a day where I saw a 
brand-new side of Gold City...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Like catching fish with your bare hands, 
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Bare-handed?
choice_data_list:
How about making leaf boats and racing 
them!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't do something that childish, 
seriously!
choice_data_list: No good, huh~
I wonder if it's no good~

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Not bad, or maybe just fresh? Though it 
does have a nostalgic feel to it."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Well, next time we hang out, how 
about coming up with a slightly better 
idea?

We still had to figure out what to 
propose... but seeing Gold City relax her 
shoulders brought a sigh of relief.
